escena: a young woman brand manager stands on the malecón of Puerto Baquerizo Moreno at sunrise holding a long cut-paper straight line that rises diagonally like a ruler, beside a crate of glass soda bottles; a sea lion naps at her feet and a frigatebird flies over the bay.

five university students in a bright room hold up different everyday objects (a mango, a seashell, a coffee cup) in front of an open laptop whose webcam glows; the laptop screen shows only colorful abstract shapes; one student strikes a pose with both arms up; a blue-footed booby watches from the window.

a young woman at a wooden table by a window overlooking the harbor arranges three large cut-paper objects: an old television, a portable radio and a folded newspaper, next to a stack of glass soda bottles; she taps her chin thinking; a sea lion peeks in through the window.

a small blue panga boat loaded with crates of glass soda bottles arrives at a village dock on a new island; on the shore a woman stands where a paper path forks in two, one long and winding, one short and straight; a volcano in the background.

a woman holds a folded newspaper in one hand and a portable radio in the other; the radio casts a long shadow that falls exactly over the newspaper, as if the newspaper were taking the credit; a curious marine iguana looks up at them from a lava rock.

a giant staircase of four cut-paper steps rises from a white sand beach toward the sky; a young woman climbs it; on each step lies a different object, from bottom to top: a magnifying glass, a stethoscope, a telescope, a compass; sea lions rest at the base.

evening in a small home in San Cristóbal; a student works on a laptop at a kitchen table with a cup of tea and paper notes under warm lamp light; through the window the harbor lights and a sea lion sleeping on the pier.
